findings.title: rework reroute excludes `implementer_engine_id` even when the rework dispatch targets a non-implementer role (e.g. an archetype whose `rework:` edge lands in `reviewing`)

the gate-attributed non-convergence reason is 117 chars for a 4-char task id and single-digit streak, so a longer id or a two-digit count clips the captured-log path at `_DRIVE_QUOTE_MAX`, contradicting the comment's claim that it is composed to fit whole

an empty/torn newest captured round leaves `rwstate=absent`, so pack.json records no `rework.md` entry at all — conflating "no round was ever captured" with "evidence exists and was withheld", the distinction the surrounding code says it preserves

after the post-green streak reset the same signature returning is journalled as "identical to the previous round" while the brief calls it "the first time this particular failure has been seen" — the two records of one round disagree
